title: XML-RPC: Publish From Desktop Blogging Clients | Orchard Core
description:
Desktop blogging clients such as Open Live Writer publish posts to a site through a remote publishing API, so the site needs an endpoint that speaks it.

The Orchard Core XML-RPC module provides that endpoint, and its Remote Publishing feature adds the MetaWeblog API. Posts go into a blog, a content item with a List part, and each module that owns a part decides how it maps to the members of a post.

In this video:
• Two features, one endpoint: what XML-RPC and Remote Publishing do
• Enabling the features: Remote Publishing and its dependency
• How a client finds your blog: the manifest and the RSD document
• What a client can do: calls, members and permissions
• A post from a client: published and draft posts
• Extending the API: drivers and handlers
